name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.212
notes: CRITICAL FIX: Lock screen could open the app on a single key tap. Unlock now requires a full verified 4-tap sequence (letter then three matching color tiles). Partial sequences only fill progress dots and never dismiss the lock.
Hardened _clUnlock so a visible configured lock cannot be hidden unless authentication just succeeded.
Neutralized leftover Secure Access Takeover code that previously overwrote _clKeyTap / _clUnlock / _clShowLock.
Lock overlay forces pointer-events and blocks background scroll while visible.
Prior 211 recovery features retained: Forgot after 4 fails, 3 recovery attempts then 5-min lockout, 8s hold to recovery to Settings.
label: SecureAccessHardLock
summary: Hard lock: single-tap can no longer open the app. Full 4-tap verification required. Takeover code neutralized.
fixes: Single key tap no longer unlocks the app.
Unlock only after verified letter + three matching color tiles.
Lock overlay blocks background interaction while shown.
testing: Set Secure Access (letter M + Purple). Tap 100% Private to lock.
Tap only M — app must stay locked; one progress dot fills.
Tap only D — app must stay locked.
Correct sequence M then three purple tiles — unlocks.
Wrong 4-tap sequence — shakes, clears dots, stays locked.
